guides.title: USGS: Surficial geology of New York (Cadwell and others, 1991)
guides.note: The statewide glacial deposits map as a GIS geodatabase, for finding lake-bed clay plains.

rules.title: 6 NYCRR 51.8: state land rules
rules.note: Bars removing or disturbing rock, soil, fossils or minerals on DEC-managed land without a written permit.

rules.title: ECL 9-0303: taking material from state lands
rules.note: No taking material belonging to the state off state lands without authorization.
